verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe multi-repo analysis that links related repositories to catch breaking changes, API mismatches, and dependency issues across repository boundaries during review. Large diffs are presented as logical cohorts and layers with range-specific summaries and diagrams, and path instructions allow targeted guidance per area of a codebase, which suits monorepos. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that cross-repo and large-diff reviews stay coherent in practice, and explicit documentation of monorepo-scale handling (e.g., package-boundary awareness or size limits).
